A precise architectural drafting control desk viewed in three-quarter perspective, an open project ledger held by a small red indexing clip, a key integrated into a control lever, and a small suspended branching mechanical assembly whose parts remain connected in a protective frame on the desk. One coherent scene, no screens, no lettering, no invented metrics, no logos. The ledger is project continuity; the key is account identity; held branching assembly is preserved unfinished work. Style prompt: sophisticated graphite and charcoal hand-drawn editorial illustration, neutral white/light gray paper, crisp linework and selective pencil texture, dark balanced shadows, a single small vermilion red accent. No pink wash, beige cast, gradients or glossy 3D render. Output: landscape 16:9, generous safe margins, readable as article cover, no text.
